items.message: Main gate test has no positive control path — if `_page_module` strips all blocks to `pass`, the test passes vacuously.

`_page_module` skips `from __future__ import annotations` lines inside blocks but includes them in the prelude, which may hide errors in pages that rely on PEP 563 semantics only inside those stripped lines.
`subprocess.import` is deferred inside the test but the same symbol is moved to module level elsewhere in the file — inconsistent style, not a defect.
